title: AI Engineer
description: About ArdenaArdena is a CDMO and CRO that helps pharmaceutical and biotech companies take complex molecules from development to market. Our 700+ colleagues cover drug substance and drug product development, GMP manufacturing, bioanalysis, clinical logistics, fill and finish, and CMC regulatory support, across five sites: Oss and Assen (the Netherlands), Ghent (Belgium), Pamplona (Spain) and Somerset, New Jersey (US).Ardena is a fast-growing company with real ambition in AI. With ArdenAI, we build our own AI tools and roll out enterprise AI across the business, from dossier drafting and proposal writing to quality investigations and lab data, safely and in line with GxP. Every colleague works with Claude Enterprise, connected to Microsoft 365. There is a lot still to build, and we would like you to be part of that journey.To grow our ArdenAI team, we are looking for an AI Engineer in the Netherlands.The roleAs AI Engineer in the ArdenAI team, you build and maintain Ardena’s own AI tools: assistants, document processing and automations that colleagues use every day. You work with the AI Implementation Lead, who decides with the business what to build and designs the solution, and with the AI Specialist, who runs our AI platform day to day. You also support our AI Specialist – Quality with solutions for QA processes. You report to the Head of AI and work with colleagues at all five sites. The role suits an engineer early in their career who wants to grow fast in applied AI, as well as a more experienced engineer.What You Will DoBuilding AI toolsBuild, test and improve AI tools and automations, such as assistants, document processing and agent workflows.Write the prompts, instructions and data sources that make our tools give reliable answers.Build skills, plugins and connectors for Claude and our other AI platforms.Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code to deliver quickly.Quality and maintenanceTest solutions against the agreed requirements before they go live.Maintain tools in use, monitor them and fix issues.Document what you build so it can be supported, changed and, where needed, validated with QA.Work securely and protect data in line with our IT and AI rules.Working with the businessWork with colleagues to understand their process and what they need.Show early versions and improve them based on feedback.Share knowledge and reusable building blocks with the team.What We Are Looking ForA degree in computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.Programming experience, preferably in Python or TypeScript.Hands-on experience building with large language models (for example prompting, retrieval or agents), at work or in your own projects.Familiarity with APIs and cloud platforms; experience with Microsoft 365 or Azure is a plus.Professional English. Dutch is an advantage.How You WorkHands-on and pragmatic: you ship working tools and keep improving them.Curious and quick to learn, because new models arrive every few months.Accurate: you know that answers in a regulated environment have to be right.A team player who explains things clearly to non-technical colleagues.Nice to haveA Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE/FDSE) certification, or experience working as an engineer embedded with business users.Experience with Claude, the Anthropic API or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).Experience with document processing or OCR.Git, automated testing and CI/CD.Experience in pharma, life sciences or another GxP-regulated environment.What We OfferA role with real impact in a learning organization, with time and budget to keep up with the latest AI toolsAn ambitious ArdenAI team and colleagues at five international sitesAn open culture with short lines of communicationAttractive employment conditions and flexible working hoursMeaningful work that helps bring medicines to patients, guided by our WE CARE values: Communicative, Accountable, Reliable, ExcellentHow To ApplyReady to apply? Please click on the application button. A link to something you built with AI, such as a GitHub repository, a demo or a short write-up, is very welcome.Only candidates eligible to work in the EU will be considered for the position. Unfortunately, given the high volume of applications we receive for our vacancies, these professionals (not entitled to work in the European Union) will not be given a status update. Agency calls will not be appreciated. Show more Show less
